title: Deep Star Maps 2020 – Galactic-coordinate Milky Way layer
credit: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center Scientific Visualization Studio. Gaia DR2: ESA/Gaia/DPAC.
projection: Galactic longitude zero at centre, increasing to the left, Galactic north at the top.
processing: Resampled linear EXR radiance onto six 2048-square cube faces. Tone mapped as 1-exp(-4.4*L), converted to sRGB and encoded as WebP at quality 92. A 256-pixel-per-face preview covers loading and missing detail.
use: Galactic overview and travelling camera. The background layer excludes the Hipparcos and Tycho foreground. Orbit Lab plots its own Hipparcos subset separately from stellar magnitudes, colours and positions.
orbitalComposite: Native angular light from the 16 registered survey fields in assets/catalog/cosmos/orbit-galaxies.json is integrated on the Galactic sphere. The inverse alpha channel stores a separately switchable low-intensity reading aid sampled at 3.6 times the angular size. A local luminance filter on the optical sky compresses sharp stellar peaks while retaining its diffuse Milky Way colour.
